description: Bus_Stops_July_2017 is a dataset listed in ACT Government open data portal (www.data.act.gov.au), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by ACT Government. Point location data of ACTION bus stops within the ACT as of July 2017. Coverage: Australian Capital Territory. The portal files it under the category Transport. Its tags are bus stops, travel, public transport. The table has 5 columns. Attribution on the portal: ACT Government. The portal shows 2017-07-18 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-act-gov-au-portal.
